purpose: Reel 'было -> стало' (old combat -> new 3-hit sabre combo): the OLD part. Clean clips, no text, no music, 9:16.
format: 1080x1920, H.264 High yuv420p bt709, 60 fps CFR, CRF 14; audio AAC 48 kHz stereo 192k as a separate stream
time_base: source_*_s are seconds from the start of the source mp4; each clip = [moment_in - 0.3 s, moment_out + 0.3 s]
source_rules: Only the owner's Xbox Game Bar recordings named 'razlom - SampleScene - ... Unity ...' from Videos\Captures; nothing else from that folder was used.
processing: Game view cropped out of the Unity editor window (2 px inside the Game view border, no editor or Windows UI).
9:16 window follows the hero (path smoothed), never letterboxed; kept above the old bottom HUD (ability bar, HP).
Game Bar records ~30 fps VFR; normalised to 60 fps CFR by frame duplication (no interpolation, no ghosting).

Windows mouse pointer (and the game's own beige pointer in 26.09) removed frame by frame: patched from the nearest frame where that spot is free, aligned for camera motion; light unsharp mask after the upscale.
